# GFit | גד פנש, מאמן כוח וריצה

> GFit is the coaching practice of Gad Fenesh (גד פנש), a strength and running coach in Israel. He coaches people who want to get stronger and run better at the same time, with a personal plan built around their goals, ability and daily routine. Clients choose combined strength and running coaching, running only, or strength only, in person or online. The first introductory talk is free.

## About the coach

- **Name**: Gad Fenesh (גד פנש)
- **Role**: Strength and running coach (מאמן כוח וריצה)
- **Background**: Reserve captain (סרן במילואים). Graduate of a fitness trainer course, a long-distance running coach course and further courses in the field.
- **Running community**: Owner of the running group "נוע" (Noa), and setting up "נוע - מתחם wellness".
- **Why the combination**: For years running cost him muscle mass and strength training weighed on his running. He learned to combine the two properly, and now helps clients progress in both without one coming at the expense of the other.
- **Instagram**: https://instagram.com/gadfenech

## What the coaching includes

1. Personal strength plan, matched to goals, level and available equipment
2. Personal running plan, matched to goals, level and ability
3. Planned combination of strength and running: load and recovery fitted to the training routine
4. Nutrition guidance matched to goals and the process
5. Digital training plan in the TrainingPeaks app, synced with the client's watch
6. Ongoing tracking and adjustments based on progress and how the client feels
7. Personal support and availability on WhatsApp
8. Regular check-in calls to review progress, set targets and adjust the plan

Tracks: strength + running, running only, or strength only.
Format: in-person training or online coaching.

## Who it's for

Beginners and people who have trained for years:

- People who want to start running or improve their running performance
- People who want to get stronger, build muscle and progress in strength training
- People who want to combine strength and running without one hurting the other
- People who want a consistent training routine instead of starting over each time
- People preparing for a specific goal: a race, a personal best or a strength target

## Client results

- **Shachar**: half marathon 1:36, 10 km 41:39, 5 km 19:56, and 5 kg of muscle mass gained.
- **Noam Ohana**: lost 13 kg, went from running 3 km to a half marathon, and reached his goal of 5 km in 23:50.
